newsitem.title: GERMANY: German producer prices unchanged in month.
newsitem.headline: German producer prices unchanged in month.

text.p: German producer prices were unchanged in December from the previous month and down 0.3 percent from a year earlier, the Federal Statistics Office said on Wednesday.
The latest data show that producer prices were tame throughout 1996, down an average 0.5 percent from 1995.
A survey of economists by Reuters had revealed a consensus prediction of a monthly rise in December of 0.1 percent and a decline of 0.2 percent from the year-earlier month.
West German producer prices were also unchanged in December, but fell 0.5 percent from the previous year.
East German December producer prices were unchanged from November and showed a rise of 1.4 percent from the previous year.
In November, German producer prices were unchanged from the month earlier and down 0.3 percent year-on-year.
